title: Notion - All-in-one workspace merging notes, docs, databases, and collaboration
clean_text: Notion merges note-taking, task management, databases, and team collaboration into a single workspace, with database views including tables, calendars, and kanban boards and a flexible block-based editor for custom layouts. As of 2025 it had grown to over 100 million users globally (up from 20 million in 2022), with more than 4 million paying customers. Notion serves individuals, freelancers, and small businesses up through large enterprises, with over 50% of Fortune 500 companies using the platform as of 2025.

meta.target: individuals and freelancers through large enterprises, 50%+ of Fortune 500
